_comment: ZeRO-3 with the optimizer state in CPU RAM. Same as ds_config.json except where noted. Use when the GPU cannot hold params + fp32 master + gradients at once: Qwen3-8B Full-FT needs 15.3 + 30.5 + 15.3 + 15.3 = 76.4GB plus activations on a 79.25GB card, which OOMs in the first backward (job 841886). Offloading the optimizer moves the 30.5GB fp32 master (and the Adam moments) to host RAM, leaving ~30GB of headroom. The optimizer step then runs on CPU, so expect slower steps; for a 100-step unlearning run that is minutes, not hours. REQUIRES more host RAM: submit with --mem=200G.
